{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black sheath dress, midi length, #000000, silk.
Charcoal wool-blend tailored jacket, knee-length, #36454F, fine gauge merino wool knit.
Black ankle boots, pointed toe, #111111, leather.
Gold drop earrings and a simple pearl necklace.
This outfit works because the black sheath dress provides an elegant silhouette perfect for the theatre environment while adhering to her request for a neat look. The charcoal wool jacket adds necessary warmth for the autumn evening without being too heavy, striking a balance between comfort and sophistication. The gold accents on her skin tones complement the artificial lighting of the venue, ensuring she feels confident and polished throughout the performance."}
